steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each benefit and cost is matched to its source. A benefit with no assumption is a gap.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 benefits or risks lack an assumption

findings.title: Risk with no mitigation
findings.fix: Name a mitigation and its owner

findings.title: Benefit with no assumption
findings.fix: State the assumption behind the benefit

findings.title: Cost line with no estimate source

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] risk-adoption.md:12  Risk with no mitigation.
       Fix: Name a mitigation and its owner.
[medium] benefit-revenue.md:19  Benefit with no assumption.
       Fix: State the assumption behind the benefit.
[medium] cost-training.csv:26  Cost line with no estimate source.

Not checked: The actual benefit.
pros: Checks a benefit with no assumption, a cost line with no estimate source, and a risk with no mitigation.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-business-case skill on the records for this review.
